name: design-workbench
//: Versions are pinned exactly, not floated with ^. A designer who opens this folder in three months must get the same build that was tested, not whatever upstream shipped since. Astro 6.4 pulls Vite 8 (rolldown), which @tailwindcss/vite 4.3 does not yet support - the exact failure this pin exists to prevent. The `overrides` block pins Vite itself: without it npm hoists a second, newer Vite for @tailwindcss/vite, Astro falls back to its own nested copy, and every `npm run design` starts with a warning a designer has no way to read. ui-kickoff re-verifies the build after scaffolding.
